newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa fuel costs up 18 pct in 9-months.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa fuel costs up 18 pct in 9-months.

text.p: German national airline Deutsche Lufthansa AG said on Thursday that the chief factor driving up its costs in the first nine months of the year was the surge in fuel expenses.
Lufthansa said that a steep rise in kerosene prices in the third quarter meant that in absolute terms fuel costs added an extra burden of 193 million marks in the first nine months.
Lufthansa said the rise in fuel expenses was unavoidable despite the hedging operations it carries out to contain the costs due to fuel prices.
Lufthansa said in its nine-month results statement that fuel costs rose 18 percent to 1.27 billion marks during the period.
